versioning.label: Add an optional field
versioning.detail: Existing success and error semantics remain valid.

versioning.label: Publish /v2 with a v1 support window
versioning.detail: The changed contract is isolated while consumers migrate.

versioning.label: Change v1 in place
versioning.detail: Existing clients receive a changed contract without a compatibility boundary.

timeouts.label: Before the server receives it
timeouts.detail: The original request never becomes server work.

timeouts.label: While payment processing runs
timeouts.detail: The handler can finish after the client deadline.

timeouts.label: After commit, before response
timeouts.detail: The payment may be captured although the client sees a timeout.

duplicates.label: Do not retry
duplicates.detail: The client waits for status evidence before another write.

duplicates.label: Retry with the same idempotency key
duplicates.detail: The server can return the recorded logical result.

duplicates.label: Retry with a new key
duplicates.detail: The server must treat this as another intent.

duplicates.label: Retry without a key
duplicates.detail: A non-idempotent replay has no durable identity.

consumers.label: Current v2 consumer
consumers.detail: The client understands the target contract and migration guidance.

consumers.label: Legacy v1 consumer
consumers.detail: The client still expects the original response and error semantics.

rollouts.label: Shadow and migrate
rollouts.detail: Measure compatibility, publish migration tools, then promote gradually.

rollouts.label: Scheduled v1 sunset
rollouts.detail: Keep v1 during a communicated window and alert remaining consumers.

rollouts.label: Immediate cutover
rollouts.detail: Route all callers to the changed behavior now.
